subject: Design Engineering Graduate Program application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Design Engineering Graduate Program listed on the Millar Merrigan careers page, with applications closing 30 October 2026 for an early 2027 start.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

Your program's focus on AutoCAD drafting, drainage, roads, sewer, water and mentoring inside the Engineering Design team is the pathway I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian consulting design-office employment, so I am looking for structured mentoring on land development civil design.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application: Design Engineering Graduate Program
paragraphs: I am applying for the Design Engineering Graduate Program advertised on your careers page. Applications close on 30 October 2026, with commencement in early 2027. Your page asks for a resume, transcript and a cover letter of up to 600 words sent to careers@millarmerrigan.com.au.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consulting design-office employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

The program's rotations through drafting, drainage, roads, sewer, water and authority processes match what I want to learn next. My resume is attached and drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I can provide academic transcripts on request.
